title: Set Up a Separate Work Profile on Your Android Phone
summary: It is possible to achieve your desired work-life balance on your smartphone. Just set up separate accounts using this built-in Android feature.
llm_summary: By using Android’s built‑in work profile feature, you can create a distinct, secure space on your phone for business apps and data, keeping it separate from your personal apps and content. This lets you switch between work and personal modes with a single tap, helping maintain a clear work‑life balance while protecting corporate information.
